items.title: List of works authored by Mr. Tsuyoshi Horigome for CQ Publishing (Summary)
items.summary: This document provides a list of 22 works by Takeshi Horigome, comprising 20 articles contributed to the monthly electronics magazine *Transistor Gijutsu* (published by CQ Publishing) and two books he authored or translated. Between 2010 and 2015, he consistently shared practical technical information regarding the creation of SPICE models and circuit simulation.Horigome_CQ_Publications_English.pdfPDFTitle and SummaryList of Publications by Takeshi Horigome (CQ Publishing) – SummaryThis document provides a list of 22 works by Takeshi Horigome, comprising 20 articles contributed to the monthly electronics magazine *Transistor Gijutsu* (published by CQ Publishing) and two books he authored or translated. Between 2010 and 2015, he consistently shared practical technical information regarding the creation of SPICE models and circuit simulation.Key Content and Structure• Books (2 titles):• *Techniques for Creating Component Models in the Standard Circuit Simulator "LTspice"* (Sole author; published June 2013)• *Collection of Practical Examples in Power Supply Circuit Design* (Co-translator; published November 2013)• *Transistor Gijutsu* Serial Articles (12 installments in total):• Series Title: "Reproducing Realistic Waveforms Using the LTspice Circuit Simulator" (July 2011 – July 2012)• Covers the creation and tuning of component models—such as diodes, capacitors, and power devices—which later served as the foundation for the aforementioned book. • Special Features & Technical Articles (7 items):• Since 2013, I have expanded my writing scope to include the modeling of energy-related technologies and next-generation power devices—such as lithium-ion batteries, electric double-layer capacitors, fuel cells, piezoelectric elements, and GaN FETs.
